reading.title: The Stock Exchange: Practical Information
reading.text: At the stock exchange, an adult learner handles a real-world responsibility and must make a clear decision. First, the adult learner considers Bull Market, Bear Market, IPO, and Market Cap. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Volume, Volatility, Index, and NASDAQ. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers NYSE, Dow Jones, Buy, and Sell. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Trade, Bid, and Ask. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. By the end, the adult learner can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
